answer_1.quote: We evaluated these models on a range of datasets for code generation tasks -in particular on the HumanEval , MBPP, MBPPsanitized datasets for code generation. For the autoformalization of MiniF2F to Isabelle, we used the dataset provided by . For text summarization, we utilized the Xsum dataset . For machine translation, we used the WMT14 French to English and German to English datasets .

answer_2.quote: Our primary evaluation metric for code generation is ranked pass@1... For the MiniF2F autoformalization task, we measure the quality using the BLEU score... For Xsum we use the Rouge-2 and Rouge-L scores for evaluation.

answer_3.quote: Normalized Reviewer (NR) computes the mean per token log p(x|y), where y is the generation and x is the prompt
